title: Run policy
description: The document that narrows what one run may do. Read once from a file outside the checkout, or later carried in a run start answer, and pinned for the run. It can only tighten what the runner binary allows; it never grants: a credential, a tool or an image it selects is one the machine defines, and it defines none.

version.description: The policy format. A runner refuses a version it does not read.

egress.description: What the session may reach through the runner's proxy.

mode.description: observe records every connection and denies only what deny names; enforce denies a connection to a host outside allow as well, and records the denial. Enforce with no allow list reaches nothing.

allow.description: Hosts the session may reach: a lower-case host name, or a *. suffix matching every host below it and not the apex itself. No ports, no paths, no schemes: paths have a key of their own. Absent means an empty list.

deny.description: Hosts the session may not reach, in allow's grammar, in either mode: a host an entry here covers is denied before allow and before the mode are consulted, and the denial is recorded with the entry as its rule. Absent means an empty list.

paths.description: The paths the session may ask of a host, by host in allow's grammar. A host listed here is one the proxy terminates TLS for, behind a wall, because a path is inside the connection: a request whose path no entry matches is denied under enforce and recorded either way, and a host not listed is reached on every path. A path is compared as the server reads it, case and all; a request whose path could be read two ways is denied.

additionalProperties.description: An empty list is no path of the host at all.

credentials.description: The credentials of the machine's this run may use, by name, behind a wall. The runner holds each outside the enclosure and the proxy sets it on the requests to the hosts it is for, which it terminates TLS for; the session never holds it. A name the machine does not define is no run.

argument.description: What the run asks the credential for, a repository say, given to the definition's adapter as one argument. The definition says what an argument may look like; one it does not provide for is no run.

tools.description: The tools of the machine's this run may reach, by name, behind a wall. The runner starts each for the run outside the enclosure; the proxy terminates TLS for the hosts it serves and hands it every request to them the policy lets through. A name the machine does not define is no run. Added in revision 2.

argument.description: What the run asks the tool for, a repository or a prefix say, given to the definition's command as one argument. The definition says what an argument may look like; one it does not provide for is no run.

image.description: The image of the machine's the run starts in, by name, behind a wall. The machine defines its images, a reference and the runtime the wall starts it under; the policy selects one and names no reference. Absent means the machine's default. A name the machine does not define is no run, and the image is fixed when the run starts. Added in revision 2.

path.description: A path from the root, matched whole, or up to a final * matched as a prefix: /repos/acme/shop, /repos/acme/shop/*. No other wildcard, no query.
